meaning: usable means eligible for language retrieval, not scientifically acceptance-passed. Alerts travel with all affected expressions. Entry rules exclude specific risky expressions; absence of a rule is not proof of source correctness.

article_alerts.restriction: Do not reuse the truncating-ATM HR 0.731 / CI 0.899–1.038 trio. KRAS-conditioned co-mutation and drug-specific experimental effects must remain separate from pooled associations.
SMARCA4 variant class, protein loss and STK11 co-occurrence are distinct. Retrospective ICI associations do not prove predictive benefit.
Preserve overall null ICI findings and exploratory subgroup limits; pathogenicity, LOH and protein loss are not interchangeable.
Separate 636-patient molecular and 151-patient advanced-treatment cohorts; no STK11-specific causal or predictive treatment claim.
Do not pool Q61H–STK11 enrichment and Q61L–STK11 exclusivity into one all-Q61 statement.
NSCLC STK11/EGFR amplification context is not STK11 treatment validation; HER2 outcome cohorts are other cancers. Do not transfer amplification cutoffs to STK11 deletion.
Adjusted ECD-versus-TKD PFS P=0.06 and CI includes 1; do not call it significant. Supplied PDF is pre-proof, not version of record.

Results prose and Figure 4 disagree on STK11/CDKN2A HR assignment. Figure4 is physical PDF p33. Physical p14 line282 says OS but Table2 physical p29 is a PFS model; do not transfer that OS label. Disclose conflicts for exact estimates. No non-durvalumab comparator. Supplied PDF is pre-proof.
Separate monoallelic deletion, biallelic inactivation, TCGA expression and treatment cohorts; preserve 19p co-deletion and ICI-alone heterogeneity.
Structural analogue only: no STK11/LKB1 analysis in supplied main text. MTAP copy number <0.6 is not an STK11 threshold.
Expression clusters differ from mutation groups. p11 prose and Fig7D conflict on knockdown IC50 direction; reopen panel before a directional drug-sensitivity claim.
Preserve response denominators, LKB1 protein versus mutation, small comparator uncertainty and unresolved source confidence-interval discrepancy. Reopen the article for exact estimates.

STK11 and/or KEAP1 is a union, not double mutation. TDCT-versus-CT and TDCT-versus-DCT differ; the latter OS CI includes 1. Human bulk inference differs from mouse scRNA. PD-L1 denominator and other source conflicts remain bounded.

Methods disagree on label-free versus TMT protein quantification; do not select either as resolved. CellChat/c4 LPA secretion is inferred, not directly measured. Internal split is not external validation.

Shorter STK11-mutant survival does not imply lower ORR: both groups45%. NRF2/OS in KEAP1WT is nonsignificant. Figure4A drug label differs from caption. Clinical associations are not predictive interactions; combinations are preclinical.

Patient prevalence and all-call/somatic-call CH proportions have different denominators. Figure1 classification direction and Figure2C mean/median labels conflict with prose. Do not implement the algorithm from this source alone.

Thoracic NUT carcinoma is not interchangeable with all NSCLC. Assay sensitivity requires modality-specific coverage denominators; no significant survival difference by detection modality. BRD4 exon and calendar labels differ across source locations.

NCI-MATCH concordance concerns shared genes and actionable entry alterations, not entire profiles. Table2 sarcoma CI does not contain its estimate. Negative plasma does not exclude tissue-defined response.

Observational treatment interaction is not randomized predictive validation. Low-volume PFS P values and FDR notation conflict within source. Olink targeted proteins are not mass-spectrometry whole-proteome data.
RET-positive-only sample selection cannot estimate clinical specificity. Abstract QC denominators conflict with Results; rescue analyses are unblinded/post hoc and not primary assay sensitivity.

VISION tissue/liquid groups overlap. Between-biopsy efficacy comparisons are descriptive without formal P values. Any-variant ctDNA detectability differs from METex14 positivity; tumor burden confounds comparisons.
Updated same261-patient MRD cohort is not external validation. Negative MRD is not proof of cure or absence of adjuvant benefit. Figure3C HR/CI conflict and invalid prose P value must not be reused.

ctMoniTR landmark/internal test split is not external validation or trial-level surrogate validation. Preserve persistent-versus-clearance reference direction and endpoint-specific denominators. Table1 totals differ from subgroup sums.

Lung-MAP Figure6 caption CI lower bound conflicts with plot/Results; Figure2 color labels conflict. High tumor fraction improves some detection while marking poorer prognosis, not treatment prediction. CNA sensitivity remains limited.

Quantified ADC target abundance is not demonstrated ADC efficacy. Unknown EGFR status is not wild type. Analytical LOD/LOQ is not a clinical response cutoff; protein calibration is targeted, not discovery proteomics.

RAS-RAF PLA is pan-RAS proximity, not KRASG12C-specific binding. Small treated-only cohort and optimized cutoff do not validate treatment selection. Table1 sex/year percentages conflict with counts; external co-mutation cohort is not this study.

DIAMOND all-model methylation validation sensitivity41% at99%specificity differs from combined91% at93%. Cancer-specific experts are not tissue-origin classifiers. Lung validation has8 metastatic cases; no early-lung screening validation.
